name: Did you know? (portrait)
description: A bold fact-of-the-day screen: a big character in a bright disc, one surprising sentence, a short explanation and a source line. For schools, libraries, museums, waiting rooms and office kitchens. Portrait 9:16 layout.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: badge
params.label: Character in the disc
params.help: One to three characters, drawn big in the coloured disc: ?, !, a number.

params.name: number
params.label: Fact number
params.help: Top right, e.g. "No. 27". Leave empty to hide.

params.name: fact
params.label: The fact
params.help: The headline: one short, surprising sentence.
params.default: An octopus has three hearts and blue blood.

params.name: detail
params.label: Explanation
params.help: One or two sentences that explain it. Enter starts a new line.
params.default: Two hearts pump blood through the gills and the third sends it round the body. The blood is blue because it carries oxygen with copper instead of iron.

params.name: footer
params.label: Footer line
params.help: A source, a series name or where to find out more.
params.default: Science Week at Northwind Library · Ask at the front desk for the reading list

params.name: show_logo
params.label: Show the logo
params.help: Off hides the logo and its space stays empty.

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: A PNG or SVG with a transparent background, in a light colour for the default dark background.

params.name: accent
params.label: Accent colour
params.help: The disc, small heading, number and rule.

params.name: background
params.label: Background colour
params.help: Behind everything. The character in the disc is drawn in this colour too.
